inspected_anchors.anchor: Grounding, source checking and deterministic executor architecture.
Admission interface, kernel, cache and source/derived separation.
Certificate gate and explicit sound-source-checker/fragment assumptions.
Conditional soundness, no-promotion invariant and independence-qualified voting lemma.
Reported native versus fallback results and main-table historical adapter rows.
Uncertified solver ablation and fixed-trace checking tradeoffs; adverse grounder regimes.
Unmeasured physical storage and cost tradeoffs; prospective validation.
Induction completion and conditional concentration proof; step/channel independence needed.
Internal protocol lacks independent timestamp; failed redundancy target and unmeasured guarantees.
Exact printed selective-policy counts; raw archive and immutable model revision gaps.
Model labels and historical comparator limitations.

supported_claims: Source admission and derived proof checking are distinct modes; state soundness assumes both sound source and fragment checkers.
Restricted writable predicates prevent direct promotion of a rule-head conclusion but do not prove allowed leaves true.
Voting concentration requires conditional independence and leaves a shared-error floor; two calls do not identify latent parameters.
Printed DeepSeek source recheck removes63 wrong and51 correct answers from2091 items; fallback is a separate uncertified channel.
Main-table adapter rows recur as unmatched historical summaries in the appendix; common display columns do not establish a matched experiment.
Protocol preregistration, complete certificates, model revisions, physical storage and prospective calibration retain explicit gaps.
limitations: Versioned arXiv original only; its ICLR2027 running header is not independently established conference acceptance.
Reported outcomes and printed-count arithmetic, not raw-record or live-model replication.
Sound source checking and channel independence are conditional assumptions, not supplied by proof validity or two agreeing calls.
Historical adapter rows are unmatched according to the appendix; no ranking or universal superiority is inferred.
No downloaded code executed; no native product, bank benefit, visual or final acceptance.
